text:
devin: Heads up: nightly perf job flagged a regression in long-context attention after yesterday's kernel selector roll.

infra-bot: CI nightly perf job failed: job/attn-microbench (seq=4096, bsz=1) exceeded latency SLA. See https://ci.redwood/... :warning:

maria: Numbers?

devin: Profiling snapshot from nsys:
```
kernel: attn_v2_paged_compat
avg token latency: 11.8ms -> 19.6ms (+66%)
throughput: 240 tok/s -> 156 tok/s (-35%)
observed: heavy GPU->CPU memcpy around KV cache warmup, high SM idling
```

sam: Which selector change caused this? we swapped heuristics last night right?

devin: Yeah, selector now prefers attn_v2_paged_compat for seq>2048 to avoid OOM on smaller GPUs. But that path calls a tiled kernel that was built with -march=native in the packaging step.

lucy: Packaging note: build image on GHA runner uses gcc12 + `-march=native`. Our runtime images use older distro toolchain (glibc + GCC9 compat). That can produce non-optimal codepaths or fall back at runtime. I saw linker notes in the packaging logs:
```
/usr/bin/ld: warning: /usr/local/lib/libcub.so: unsupported GNU_PROPERTY_1: kind=0
```

devin: Also observed fallback kernels being selected at runtime due to illegal insn on some CI runners, but no crash — just slower codepath.

maria: Repro steps someone can run locally?

devin: Repro:
```
docker run --rm -it --gpus all rwinference/dev-runtime:nightly /bin/bash
python -m benchmarks.attn --seq 4096 --bs 1 --kernel-selector=auto
nsys profile -o out.nsys --trace=nvtx python run_bench.py
```
Then `nsys` report shows memcpy spikes and kernel durations.

sam: Quick fix: can we change build flags to `-march=x86-64-v2 -mtune=generic` and remove -march=native? Also add multi-target build artifacts.

lucy: Agreed. Also add a runtime CPU feature check so selector avoids kernels compiled for newer ISAs.

devin: I'll open a PR to revert the roll and add a packaging change. tagging @ryan for CI image rebuild.

ryan: on it. I'll try rebuilding libattn with GCC11 on Ubuntu22 image and test matrix across our runtime images. ETA EOD.

maria: thanks. if anyone finds new diffs post-PR ping here. :eyes:

infra-bot: deploy-bot: selector-rollout reverted for canary cluster. :white_check_mark:

sam: follow-up: add a small perf test to our CI that runs seq 2048/4096 kernels for canary, threshold delta 15%.

devin: adding that to the perf suite now.
